The upstream random17 SimplePaddedStruct NaNf generation failure is retained separately in known-limitations.json and evidence; it is not a compiler bug.
The induced float/integer mismatch is an intentional negative control.
Bundled Rust auxiliary ELF tools use the explicitly declared package-local library path; activate it for direct SDK use.
